headline: I build the backend your business runs on.
tagline: I design, optimize and run production services, APIs and data processes. I work with the team to find the bottleneck, measure it and fix it with the simplest solution that works.
stackLine: Python · TypeScript · Go · SQL · Linux · AWS
description: Backend developer: production services, APIs and data processes with Python, TypeScript, Go and SQL on Linux and AWS, with frontend experience.
about: I got into technology at a young age, but it was at 18, when I started my degree, that I found out what I am good at: understanding why a system is slow or fragile and leaving it running well. It is the work I enjoy most, and it rarely starts from scratch: there is a system in use, a budget and decisions already made.

I start from what the business needs, measure before I change anything and pick the simplest solution that solves it. I own what I ship from design to production on Linux and AWS. Backend is where I go deepest; I also work on data and interfaces, so work does not stall at the boundary between teams.

I was born in Santa Marta and have lived there most of my life. I like music, basketball, Linux ricing and movies, and above all I love horror stories. In my free time I go to the cinema, head to the beach, build something or simply watch a film.
